cells.cmd: startproject; startapp; generate; completion; version; help
cells.effect: Scaffold explicitly selected target; regenerate typed symbols; shell completion/help/version require no database.
Dev/production server; supported validated build; checks read-only; settings output redacts secrets.

cells.cmd: makemigrations [--check/--dry-run/--merge]; migrate [--plan/--fake/--fake-initial]; showmigrations; sqlmigrate; squashmigrations; optimizemigration; migrate --prune
cells.effect: Generation separate from DB execution; destructive/history-only choices explicit; no automatic production migrations on startup.
dbshell launches psql using safe process args/env; secrets not argv/logs; SQL previews read-only; backfill is resumable explicit operation.
Dump streaming; load validates and commits boundary; flush requires exact database target and confirmation, never part of ordinary migrate.

cells.cmd: createsuperuser; changepassword; createuser; rotate-signing-key; cleartokens; clearsessions
cells.effect: Prompt/no-input required values enforced; password via secure stdin not shell arg; rotation updates config secret reference, never prints active key.
Manifest collection and lookup; upload cleanup previews exact staged/orphan records then grace-period delete; unrelated paths untouched.
Extract templates/Go marked literals and JS messages; compile deterministic catalogs; plural/context errors fail.

cells.cmd: test; testserver; test --race; test --integration; test --keepdb; sendtestemail
cells.effect: Isolated test database/Redis namespace; testserver fixture sandbox not production DB; sendtestemail explicitly sends only requested test recipient.
Compile/run supplied Go management callback with project imports; not a Python-style arbitrary Go interpreter; optional external REPL integration separately selected.

cells.cmd: worker; beat; tasks inspect/status/result/revoke/retry; queues inspect/purge/quarantine/replay
cells.effect: Worker/beat separate roles; operator commands authenticated when remote; purge previews exact queue and requires confirmation; active effects not undone.

cells.cmd: health; routes; schema; openapi; dbcheck; connector-check
cells.effect: Read-only inventories/checks; redacted output; connector conformance commands use test service only.

cells.cmd: remove_stale_contenttypes; clearsitescache; sitemap; custom app commands
cells.effect: Stale contenttype cleanup previews referenced data and refuses implicit cascade; app commands declare resource/access/write needs.
